headword: {紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん}
reading: こうはくうたがっせん
gloss: NHK New Year's Eve music special

definitions.gloss: NHK Kōhaku Uta Gassen; annual New Year's Eve singing competition on NHK
definitions.explanation: Japan's most-watched annual TV broadcast, airing on NHK every New Year's Eve (December 31). Popular singers are divided into two teams — Red (female artists) and White (male artists) — who compete in performances judged by audience and panel. A cultural milestone since 1951.

notes:
The full name is NHK{紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん}; commonly called simply ⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧ in conversation. First broadcast in 1951, it remains one of Japan's highest-rated television programs.

{紅組|あかぐみ} (Red team) features female artists; {白組|しろぐみ} (White team) features male artists. Which team wins is decided by audience vote and an on-site panel.
